correctness.rationale: All right quotients are classified by residual length and number of remaining marked symbols. The one-marker prefix domain is exactly two integer rectangles; all possible quotient identifications are exhausted and give min((h-ell)^2,(ell+1)^2) paired collapses. The case a=b and n=2 is explicitly covered. Independent trie minimization verified 300 parameter pairs and direct quotient enumeration verified 45 pairs. Finite checks are corroborative; deductive proof handles all a,b>=0.
